newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telebras sags in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telebras sags in New York.

text.p: Telebras fell slightly in New York trading on Thursday despite a step forward in its breakup as Brazil's state telecommunications holding.

Telebras American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) fell 1/4 to 73-5/8 after rising to 74-7/8. Volume was a moderate 731,000 shares after the Brazilian government submission of a bill that would allow the company's breakup and sale and creation of a new state regulatory agency.
"Everybody was waiting for the submission. That was already in the price," one trader said.
"It's being held down by the Dow and with the expiration of options settlements" next week in Sao Paulo. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was off nine points in late-morning trade.

Among other ADRs, Canada's Barrick Gold Corp rose 5/8 to 29 after Indonesian officials cast doubts on rival Bre-X Minerals Ltd's rights to develop a huge gold deposit alone. Indonesia has said the companies must submit joint applications for the find.
Italy's Luxottica Group SpA fell 4-1/2 to 60-1/4 after Merrill Lynch cut its ratings for the company.
Advancers led decliners 256 to 206 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 27.6 million shares.
